name: Chongqing Zaisheng Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: Chongqing Zaisheng Technology Co., Ltd. engages in the research, development, production, and application of ultrafine glass fiber wool in China. It offers home comfort dust-free air conditioning, automotive cabin filter pack, melt-blown filter media, ePTEE membranes, glass fiber filter media, composite melt-blown filtration material, composite PTFE filtration material, glass microfiber air-laid mat/bag, air/liquid coalescing media, and HEPA filter pack/filter.
